title: Crawler Log Folder
summary: The Leetcode file system records user actions for navigating folders.
statement: The Leetcode file system records user actions for navigating folders. These actions include moving to the parent folder using "../", remaining in the current folder using "./", or moving to a child folder specified by "x/". Given a sequence of these actions, determine the minimum number of actions needed to return to the main folder.
constraints: 1–1,000 operations; each is ../, ./, or a child-folder name ending in /.
The crawler begins at the main folder and cannot move above it. Return the remaining depth.
hints: Only the current depth matters; folder names do not.
Increment for a child, decrement a positive depth for parent, and ignore stay.
Scan the log while clamping every parent move at zero.
These three transitions exactly reproduce the stack size without storing folder names.
editorial: These three transitions exactly reproduce the stack size without storing folder names.

tests.explanation: The two child moves left after processing the parent and stay operations require two returns.
Returning at the main folder keeps the depth at zero.
